title: Integrability and sup-mass bound for a bounded continuous function vanishing off a ball of finite measure
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let ν be a measure on ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with its Borel σ-algebra. Let a ∈ ℝ^N and ρ, M ∈ ℝ. Let g : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous with |g(y)| ≤ M for every y, and such that g(y) ≠ 0 implies y ∈ B_ρ(a) (open ball). If ν(B_ρ(a)) < ∞, then g is ν-integrable and |∫ g dν| ≤ M · ν.real(B_ρ(a)). Here ν.real(B_ρ(a)) = (ν(B_ρ(a))).toReal is the real value of the finite measure of the ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Rn N)) (a : Rn N) (ρ M : ℝ) (g : Rn N → ℝ), ν (Metric.ball a ρ) < ∞ → Continuous g → (∀ y, |g y| ≤ M) → (∀ y, g y ≠ 0 → y ∈ Metric.ball a ρ) → Integrable g ν ∧ |∫ y, g y ∂ν| ≤ M * ν.real (Metric.ball a ρ)
